可见的亮光来自视界外的高温气体，而非黑洞内部。吸积涉及角动量输运；喷流还需合适的: Visible light comes from hot gas outside the horizon, not the black-hole interior. Accretion involves angular-momentum transport. Jets need suitable magnetic and accretion conditions and do not accompany every disruption.
Rₛ 是无自旋黑洞的事件视界半径。图中黑色核心仅作位置示意，未根据物理质量按比例: Rₛ is the event-horizon radius of a nonrotating black hole. The black core is a location marker, not a mass-scaled physical size, and relativistic ray tracing is not performed.
“发光的是黑洞旁边的热气体。黑洞里面的光，出不来。”: “The hot gas beside the black hole shines. Light from inside cannot get out.”
亮边不是事件视界发光；喷流不是黑洞把已经吞进去的光再吐出来。: The bright edge is not a shining event horizon; jets do not release light already swallowed by the black hole.
保留同一颗示意恒星、黑洞引力参数及抛物线入射，减小近心距。气体继承恒星的运动速度: Keep the same illustrative star, gravity parameter and parabolic approach, but reduce pericenter distance. Gas inherits the stellar velocity; integrated trajectories determine what crosses the inner boundary, rather than a preassigned fraction.
近黑洞区域的牛顿模型只能定性演示。黑色核心是吸收边界，不能用本图确定真实相对论捕: Newtonian motion near a black hole is qualitative only. The black core is an absorbing boundary, not a way to determine a real relativistic capture threshold.
不同位置的气体具有不同的轨道能量和角动量。即使内侧引力更强，气体仍带有切向速度；: Gas at different positions has different energy and angular momentum. Even with stronger inner gravity, it retains tangential velocity; infall depends on the whole trajectory, not force magnitude alone.
hᵢ 是单位质量角动量。相同速度、不同位置也可产生不同 hᵢ；真实内落阈值还涉及: hᵢ is angular momentum per unit mass. The same velocity at different positions can give different hᵢ; real infall thresholds also involve black-hole spin and relativity.
首次经过时的内边界捕获: Capture at the inner boundary on first passage
更深的路线中，一部分气体轨迹在首次经过时穿过模型内边界，随后永久停止显示；仍在外: On the deeper route, some trajectories cross the inner boundary on their first pass and are permanently hidden. Exterior gas continues integrating. The infall fraction is an illustrative-model result, not a prediction for a real event.
rᵢ < r内界 → 从外部气流移除: rᵢ < r_inner → remove from the exterior stream
采用吸收边界模拟进入黑洞。没有计算相对论光传播、引力红移或远方观测者看到的渐暗过: An absorbing boundary represents entry into the black hole. Relativistic light propagation, gravitational redshift and the fading seen by a distant observer are not calculated.
“这回有的气体先落进去了，外面的气体还在继续绕行。”: “Some gas has fallen in already, while the gas outside keeps going around.”
不要把“进入潮汐范围”“被束缚在轨道上”和“跨过事件视界”说成同一件事。: Entering the tidal region, becoming gravitationally bound and crossing the event horizon are three different events.
“有些已经进去，有些还在外面。我们看看外面的气体接着往哪走。”: “Some is inside and some is still outside. Where will the outer gas go next?”
末段平滑放慢播放时钟，简化阻尼持续移除气体的角动量，使其向内旋转。跨过模型内边界: The final stage smoothly slows the playback clock. Simplified damping continues removing angular momentum so gas spirals inward. Crossing the inner boundary permanently removes it, gradually reducing the exterior stream.
“我们慢慢看，气体一边转一边靠近。落进去以后，外面的气体就少了一些。”: “Watch slowly as it turns and moves closer. Once some falls in, less gas remains outside.”
展示时长和长期耗散经过教学调整，不应用来预测气体盘寿命或吞入比例。: Display duration and long-term dissipation are adjusted for teaching, not for predicting disk lifetimes or swallowed fractions.
末段留出约一分钟观察气体持续内旋、跨越模型内边界并逐步减少。速度阻尼是角动量损失: The final minute shows continued inspiral, crossing of the inner boundary and declining gas. Velocity damping approximates angular-momentum loss for teaching; real transport is not solved.
回流和聚盘不等于已经吞入。长期耗散与展示时间经过教学调整，不是对真实稳态和吸积时: Return and disk formation do not mean the gas is already swallowed. Dissipation and presentation time are adjusted for teaching, not predictions of steady states or accretion times.

可以先比较「没有黑洞」与「安全绕过」：两者共用初始位置和速度，前者匀速直行，后者: Start by comparing “No black hole” and “Safe flyby”: they share initial position and velocity, but one moves straight while gravity bends the other. Then compare “Disruption & return” and “Deeper passage”. Ask how the path, shape and final appearance differ. This is a Sun-like star, not a claim that our Sun is approaching a black hole.
路过，不一定被吞掉: Passing does not always mean being swallowed
恒星的去向取决于轨道与潮汐作用。距离足够远时可以完整飞掠；非常靠近时，恒星两侧受: The outcome depends on orbit and tides. A distant star can pass intact; very close in, gravity differences across it may overwhelm self-gravity and cause tidal disruption. Partial disruption is also possible. “Deeper passage” reduces the closest distance, causing some gas to cross the model's inner boundary on the first pass; not every disruption does this.
黑洞周围为什么会亮？: Why is the region around a black hole bright?
发光的是视界外的炽热气体。部分瓦解气体可能逃离，部分可能留下，经碰撞和能量损失逐: Hot gas outside the horizon emits the light. Some disrupted gas may escape and some remain, gradually forming a disk after collisions and energy loss. The shares are not always one half. Jets are not universal or light escaping from inside the horizon; this animation shows no jets.
怎样理解画面里的线和比例？: How should we read the lines and scales?
金色线表示路线，橙色虚线表示潮汐作用较强的参考范围，它不是真实存在的边界，也不等: Gold marks the route; orange dashes mark a reference region of strong tides, not a physical boundary or the event horizon. The black core and thin bright edge locate the black hole; the edge is a visual marker, not a computed photon ring. Gas keeps its natural color family; inward spiraling, declining amounts and disappearance at the boundary show infall. An overlay prevents soft particle edges from spilling into the black region. Gas reappearing after occlusion in side or free views has not escaped across the boundary. Relativistic light propagation is not solved.
完整恒星采用牛顿引力下的抛物线飞掠。瓦解过程用逐渐减弱的内部支撑近似，同一批气体: The intact star follows a Newtonian parabolic flyby. Fading internal support approximates disruption while the same gas parcels keep moving; simplified later damping illustrates dissipation and inward motion. Fluid dynamics, magnetic fields and relativistic light propagation are not solved. Near the black hole this is qualitative only: the absorbing boundary does not model relativistic capture thresholds or redshift. Sizes, colors and time are adjusted for visibility, not measurement. Both disruption routes last two minutes; the final stage slows smoothly as gas spirals in and diminishes. This is not a permanent steady state; the finished scene remains visible. Music is artistic sound design, not sound traveling through a vacuum.
